purpose: Freeze a source-aware direct global amino-acid5mer representation before any biological feature fit; no prediction or sequence generation
timing: After deposited character/annotation inspection and synthetic tests; before first real5mer feature fit or model results. Target outcomes were previously visible.
rules: Fit kmer vocabulary, rare-protein filter and occurrence-pattern merging on training samples only
Count each kmer once per original protein, including when the same kmer occurs on both sides of X
Keep depositedU as its own residue symbol; do not conflate it with unknownX
Skip only existing windows containingX; do not deleteX, bridge its neighbors or split oneprotein into artificially independent proteins
Reject unsupportedcharacters, emptyproteins or missingproteomes; never silently clean or drop a sample
Preserve depositedNterminalannotationstrings; do not replace V/L/I withM
Project by union of all members sharing a trainingpattern; keep vocabulary fixed for heldouttarget samples
Preserve and report zerovectors, totalwindows, skippedXwindows and depositedX/Ucounts
No equivalence claim to upstream novel-genome protein-family assignment
interpretation: A representation candidate, preserving all source samples and annotation uncertainty. Source correspondence, relatedness groups, labels, model specification and endpoint applicability still require a separate pre-score contract.
